4 R&D and Technology Partnerships
On August 20, 2026, Charles River Laboratories collaborated with Medigen Vaccine Biologics
Corp. to characterize and validate the virus seed bank for MVC's next-generation multivalent
enterovirus vaccine by leveraging advanced analytical platforms including Next-Generation
Sequencing.
Source: Press release · Charles River - News Releases / Press Releases Aug 20, 2026
5 C-Level Executive Moves No signal in August
Business Developments
Target technology Virus validation and master/working cell bank characterization
On August 20, 2026, Charles River Laboratories partnered with Medigen Vaccine Biologics Corp. to
characterize and validate the virus seed bank for MVC's next-generation multivalent enterovirus vaccine. The
companies will leverage advanced analytical platforms including Next-Generation Sequencing to accelerate
high-quality vaccine development and support global regulatory readiness.
Source: Press release · Charles River - News Releases / Press Releases Aug 20, 2026

1 Geopolitical Supply Chain Resilience No signal in August
2 Production Expansion & Footprint Diversification No signal in August

4 R&D and Technology Partnerships
Boeing Investment and Technology Collaboration
Boeing signed definitive agreements to transfer Wisk Aero and other subsidiaries to Archer
while taking a stake in Archer and establishing an ongoing technology sharing and collaboration
arrangement.
Source: Press release · Boeing - News Releases and Statements / Press Releases / Statements Aug 10, 2026
5 C-Level Executive Moves No signal in August
Business Developments
Target technology Electric motors and high-power battery propulsion modules for aircraft
Boeing has signed definitive agreements to transfer its Wisk Aero, SkyGrid, and Insitu subsidiaries to Archer
Aviation. Under the transaction, Boeing will take a stake in Archer and establish an ongoing collaboration and
technology-sharing arrangement. The partnership combines Wisk's pioneering eVTOL and autonomy
technologies with Archer's platform to advance the aerospace and defense sector.
Source: Press release · Boeing - News Releases and Statements / Press Releases / Statements Aug 10, 2026

Signal Details by Company
Ouster
Lidar & 3D Sensing USA
1 Geopolitical Supply Chain Resilience No signal in August
2 Production Expansion & Footprint Diversification
Ouster is expanding its LiDAR production capacity to support rising demand, with its production
run rate expected to increase from approximately 40,000 units annually toward 100,000 units.
Source: Yahoo Finance Aug 17, 2026
3 Capital Raising & Liquidity Securing No signal in August
4 R&D and Technology Partnerships No signal in August
5 C-Level Executive Moves No signal in August
Business Developments
Target technology Lidar sensors for robots
Ouster launched Rev8, the world's first native color LiDAR sensor, in the second quarter of 2026. Customer
adoption was reflected in several orders exceeding $1 million from major industry leaders, including the world's
largest heavy machinery manufacturer. In addition, the company secured a significant contract with the Utah
Department of Transportation for its largest LiDAR deployment to cover several hundred intersections across
the state.
Source: Yahoo Finance Aug 17, 2026

Signal Details by Company
Nexeon
Battery Anode Materials UK
1 Geopolitical Supply Chain Resilience No signal in August
2 Production Expansion & Footprint Diversification No signal in August
3 Capital Raising & Liquidity Securing
Completion of £100 Million Investment Round.
The completion of the £100 million ($133 million) investment round includes a £52.6 million ($70
million) commitment from the National Wealth Fund along with new investors Korea
Development Bank and Honda Xcelerator Ventures, supporting continued scale-up and
commercialisation activities.
Source: Nexeon - Media / Newsroom Aug 31, 2026
4 R&D and Technology Partnerships No signal in August
5 C-Level Executive Moves No signal in August
Business Developments
Target technology CVD silicon-carbon (Si-C) anode materials
Nexeon has completed its latest investment round totalling £100 million ($133 million), backed by the National
Wealth Fund, Korea Development Bank, and Honda Xcelerator Ventures. The funding will support the
development of a UK-based pilot manufacturing facility and the expansion of its advanced manufacturing
technology unit. Additionally, Nexeon recently brought online the world's first volume production facility for
silicon-carbon materials in Gunsan, South Korea.
Source: Nexeon - Media / Newsroom Aug 31, 2026

Global Business Developments by Company
ThesecompanieshadnosignalsinAugustbutreporteddevelopmentstieddirectlytotheirtargettechnologies.Cardswithoutatarget
technology cover all of a company's businesses. All are monitored for emerging signals.
Albemarle
Lithium & Cathode Materials USA
Target technology Cathode raw materials (lithium hydroxide, lithium carbonate)
August Developments
Albemarle reported $1.3 billion in Energy Storage net sales and 65 kilotons LCE in sales volume for the second
quarter of 2026. Increased output from the Wodgina mine partially offset the delay in the Talison CGP3 ramp due
to a fire, with full-year sales volumes expected to range between 225 and 235 kilotons LCE.
Source: Albemarle - Newsroom / News Aug 5, 2026
